majorDefectFoundAndFixed.defect: global-lift branch minted its id via regionIdOf(scope, landmarkKey, childPath) which IGNORES rootTag, while the grouping key INCLUDES rootTag — so a landmark rendering as a different tag at mobile on EVERY non-locale page lifted both tag-variants to global with the identical id and hit `throw new RegionCompileError(duplicate global region id)`. Result: exit 1, NO artifact at all — total compile failure on a legitimate responsive-markup input.
majorDefectFoundAndFixed.whyItSurvived: both canaries report viewportRootMismatches=0 and no check in the 50-check suite asserted otherwise; the branch had zero coverage
majorDefectFoundAndFixed.fix: src/regions/compile.ts global id assignment pass — lifted groups bucketed by unsuffixed base id; a base id with ONE group keeps the id verbatim (backward compat), several are ranked so the variant with fewest @mobile drafts keeps the plain id; duplicate throw retained as a backstop
majorDefectFoundAndFixed.reachabilityProof: at most TWO global variants per base id are reachable (one draft per page per root tag; a group missing a page is not global). Page scope is protected by the per-page drafts Map keyed on landmarkKey|childPath + @mobile, so no other collision of this shape is reachable.

PageRegion granularity is NOT uniform and a consumer must not assume it is: linear has 25 regions on the homepage but 7 on /changelog, whose 3,234 bindings sit in a handful of large regions because that page's main content carries no sectioning markup
